source: ENTSO-E A44; system price Nord Pool
normal_method: Unsmoothed average of the same month/day in 2021–2025. Feb 29 uses the available leap years. A day is the mean of all complete Europe/Zurich delivery-hour or 15-minute prices. Country values are equal-weight bidding-zone averages, not load-weighted. Nordic is the official Nord Pool system price.

Nordic.definition: official unconstrained Nordic system price, not country average

SE.definition: equal-weight average of bidding zones, not load-weighted

NO.definition: equal-weight average of bidding zones, not load-weighted

DK.definition: equal-weight average of bidding zones, not load-weighted
